title: Agent Q v2 implementation milestones
format_note: Repository planning format; not an AQ daemon import schema. No live tasks or issues are created by this file.
dependency_semantics: depends_on contains hard prerequisites. Milestones group acceptance, not automatic start barriers. Ready means planned with all explicit dependencies complete; it is not permission to deploy or publish.
definition_of_done: Implementation and tests reviewed in the owning repository against an immutable source revision.
Acceptance evidence records exact commands, environment, artifact identity and remaining limits.
Consume public interfaces only; no sibling private state or mandatory sibling source checkout.
Update requirement evidence and dependent product pins when applicable. A passing component suite does not close a product gate.

milestones.title: Implementation audit and executable task plan
milestones.outcome: Evidence-labelled baseline and validated dependency graph.

milestones.title: Execution contract and independently packaged connector
milestones.outcome: Compatible foundation connector extracted and consumed as a pinned artifact; execution contract shared by both sides.

milestones.title: Minimal distributed fake-agent execution
milestones.outcome: One daemon and worker complete a durable synthetic assignment without duplicate launch.

milestones.title: Recovery and cancellation proof
milestones.outcome: Ambiguous launch, restart, lease expiry, cancellation and late results remain safe and explicit.

milestones.title: Real agent context, source handoff and graph outcome
milestones.outcome: One profile-resolved Codex CLI agent runs in guarded tmux, reads scoped context, edits a supported repository, hands source off and records a version-checked outcome.

milestones.title: Policy-driven coding and operational workflows
milestones.outcome: Embedded playbooks invoke real AQ adapters for coding/review/check, routing, watcher and reporting pilot flows. Session health/stall policy, accounting, verified waits/hibernation and notification/escalation/digest services pass integration with designated fake external peers.

milestones.title: Usable, measured and upgradeable product candidate
milestones.outcome: All four named harnesses, profile/session inspection and remote terminal control, exact-artifact assembly, upgrades, target-host recovery and a declared capacity envelope pass product acceptance. Session operations, actual external human delivery and retained cross-node wake pass INT-03.

tasks.title: Record implementation audit and validate the task graph
tasks.scope: Inspect local source, test definitions and existing evidence; identify missing product behavior and hard dependencies.
acceptance: Audit distinguishes implemented, recorded validation, partial, design-only and externally unverified behavior.
Snapshot and graph are retained; all links, IDs, dependency edges, reachability and acyclicity validate.

tasks.title: Qualify the existing foundation baseline
tasks.scope: Select the current foundation revision and run its applicable Rust, PostgreSQL, connector and update-lifecycle checks; reconcile existing Phase 1 work before extraction.
acceptance: Record exact revision, commands, outcomes and image identities; distinguish local evidence from hosted qualification.
Retain compatibility fixtures for enrollment, heartbeat, probe, credential revocation, persisted identity and update state formats.
out_of_scope: Reimplementing working foundation features
Provisioning or changing a live deployment

tasks.title: Publish the execution contract and conformance fixtures
tasks.scope: Specify and implement wire schemas/types, explicit capability/version negotiation, replay identities, bounded exchanges, fake coordinator/worker fixtures and both-side review.
acceptance: Fixtures cover changed-payload conflicts, grant/reservation expiry, observation sequencing, cancellation, retained-result reporting and reconciliation.
Schema/type drift checks run standalone; foundation v1 meanings remain unchanged.

tasks.title: Extract the foundation connector into aq-worker
tasks.scope: Move compatible connector behavior into a standalone Rust workspace with published wire dependencies, configuration/identity continuity, independent CI and an immutable integration image.
acceptance: Enrollment, reconnect, heartbeat and revocation tests run without the agent-q source checkout.
Reusing an existing node configuration preserves identity; candidate artifact records exact source and dependency versions.
out_of_scope: Launching agents during extraction
Changing foundation protocol semantics

tasks.title: Consume the standalone connector and remove duplicate ownership
tasks.scope: Update development, smoke and release wiring to use the pinned worker candidate and shared public wire contract; retire the duplicate production connector source after compatibility passes.
acceptance: Existing enroll/heartbeat/restart/revoke smoke passes with the standalone artifact.
Normal AQ builds no longer require an in-tree worker implementation or sibling source path.

tasks.title: Add reproducible integration assembly and explicit local overrides
tasks.scope: Provide a small product fixture selecting exact server/worker artifacts and contract versions, with reusable slots for later graph/Git/playbook dependencies.
acceptance: One documented command assembles an isolated fixture without changing developer or production state.
Official candidate inputs reject floating references/local overrides; explicit development overrides identify their source.
out_of_scope: Requiring all component source checkouts
Completing the composite updater

tasks.title: Accept contract and connector compatibility
tasks.scope: Run both-side contract checks and the existing foundation lifecycle using the pinned standalone worker.
acceptance: Exact-artifact enrollment, reconnect and revocation pass; unsupported execution is declined while allowed foundation connectivity remains visible.
Publish the tested contract/candidate references for downstream tasks.

tasks.title: Qualify an immutable graph integration candidate
tasks.scope: Reuse the existing service; select an exact candidate, reproduce current contract/storage checks, and document receipt, principal, API and schema compatibility for AQ.
acceptance: Retain current tests and an isolated backup/restore result for the selected artifact; do not substitute old benchmark evidence.
Consumer contract documents version conflicts, identical-key replay, credential lifecycle and receipt retention; versioned image is reproducible.
out_of_scope: Offline replicas
V1 migration
Execution claims in aq-graph

tasks.title: Qualify and package an immutable Git integration candidate
tasks.scope: Preserve the current implementation, select a committed candidate, verify correctness/process handoff and package a checksummed executable with honest profile/compatibility limits.
acceptance: Run the retained-source worker-loss scenario and current required correctness checks against the candidate.
Manifest ties binary to build/source; unsupported repository features are explicit and rejected; remaining performance, host-power-loss and hosted-transport gates remain named.
out_of_scope: Claiming local process tests certify host power loss
Adding every unsupported Git feature

tasks.title: Qualify the existing playbook implementation as a library candidate
tasks.scope: Reconcile concurrent implementation work, select the revision beyond the design-only commit, qualify library/CLI artifacts and current core/PostgreSQL/pilot evidence, and publish the Host/storage contract.
acceptance: Database-free tests and explicitly enabled isolated PostgreSQL tests pass on the selected candidate.

Limits and evidence for synchronous storage, snapshot/index/retention behavior, exact pins, join typing, optional protection and host-only functionality are included in compatibility metadata; the old test report does not certify new code.
out_of_scope: Rewriting the engine
Claiming fake-host pilots are AQ integration

tasks.title: Persist execution authority and immutable attempt inputs
tasks.scope: Add migrations and transactional transitions for attempts, sessions, node incarnations, offers, generations, grants and resolved specification digests.
acceptance: Concurrent claims/acceptances cannot grant conflicting authority; duplicate IDs with different bytes fail.
Restart preserves authority and deadlines; state-format/recovery rules are updated with the migration.

tasks.title: Implement worker exchanges and durable result dispositions
tasks.scope: Implement incarnation registration, bounded poll/accept/decline, renewal, sequenced progress and immutable report admission with fake-worker tests.
acceptance: Lost acceptance/report acknowledgements return original committed dispositions without duplicate launches or outcomes.
Stale boot/generation and expired local reservation reports cannot settle a current attempt.

tasks.title: Implement local journal, capacity reservation and grant admission
tasks.scope: Add versioned durable records, exclusive runtime ownership, bounded node-wide resource reservations and acceptance/grant validation using the fake coordinator.
acceptance: Crash/replay and racing offers cannot over-allocate capacity; durable state survives full-disk/write-failure injection.
Late grants cannot resurrect expired reservations; no project-by-slot preallocation is introduced.

tasks.title: Launch and report one deterministic fake agent
tasks.scope: Implement a deterministic harness/execution adapter and journaled launch identity, phase observations, writer-stop proof and report retry.
acceptance: Fixture process completes through collecting/reporting/acknowledgement with one session per attempt.
Launch-window uncertainty never causes blind relaunch; confirmed stopped writers are required before resource reuse.

tasks.title: Add test-only deterministic assignment scheduling
tasks.scope: Drive the initial execution fixture from explicitly preapproved synthetic task/context inputs and deterministic compatible-node selection.
acceptance: Fixture assignments use production authority transitions and worker local admission.
Synthetic task provider is excluded from production configuration and cannot imply graph completion.
out_of_scope: Production graph-ready scheduling
Optimized fleet placement

tasks.title: Demonstrate minimal distributed execution
tasks.scope: Extend the product fixture to run the deterministic fake agent through actual daemon/worker transport and persisted state.
acceptance: One assignment completes; repeated polls, lost acceptance response and lost report acknowledgement do not create duplicate execution.
Retain an executable demonstration with exact images, logs and correlation IDs; no model provider is required.

tasks.title: Implement cancellation, reconciliation and bounded retry policy
tasks.scope: Serialize cancellation/result eligibility, persist directives and retry lineage/budgets, reconcile old boots/grants and keep uncertain attempts visible.
acceptance: Cancellation/completion races and late superseded reports have stable outcomes; expiry never proves physical termination.
Daemon restart replays outstanding intents without extending old grants; unsafe overlapping attempts remain held.

tasks.title: Prove process ownership, expiry and restart recovery
tasks.scope: Implement discoverable process ownership across parent-only crashes, suspend-aware grant deadlines, stop escalation, reattachment checks and drain recovery.
acceptance: Inject crashes before/after spawn and restart with surviving descendants; uncertain writers keep reservations/workspaces protected.
Expiry/revocation stops execution; reattachment requires renewed authority; new execution uses a new attempt/session.
out_of_scope: Live reattachment, whole-container/PID-namespace recovery without durable stop evidence, external-service writers and hostile process/file manipulation.
Physical suspend/power-loss and real harness/source retention qualification remain later integration/target-host work.

tasks.title: Accept distributed recovery and cancellation
tasks.scope: Inject transport loss, cancellation races, daemon/worker restarts and expired authority against the real execution fixture.
acceptance: X1-X3 and X5-X9 pass with explicit uncertainty; no duplicate settlement or unsafe reuse.
Control requests retain capacity under synthetic transfer load; injected failures are repeatable without wall-clock sleep races.
out_of_scope: Qualification is the cooperative Linux guardian synthetic execution profile with runtime-process restart; guardian loss retains uncertainty.
Real graph/Git delivery, production harnesses, physical suspend/power loss and fleet capacity remain M4-M6 gates.

tasks.title: Publish scoped agent API contracts
tasks.scope: Define versioned graph context/search/mutation and operation-status schemas, capability scopes, provenance, expected versions, node recovery and CLI client contracts.
acceptance: Schema fixtures cover every batch/edge/context scope and pending/conflict/confirmed distinction.
No raw arbitrary graph proxy or worker graph credential is required; public contract supports independently generated clients.

tasks.title: Implement session credentials and scoped graph reads
tasks.scope: Provision protected per-attempt credentials, enforce current generation/expiry/revocation, and expose bounded authorized context/search/revision reads through the graph service.
acceptance: Search snippets, pagination, context expansion and relationship endpoints cannot leak out-of-scope data.
Cached context is revision-labelled; worker/node/graph service identities cannot be substituted for agent authority.

tasks.title: Implement durable graph mutation delivery and recovery
tasks.scope: Persist authorized immutable graph intent, expected versions and idempotency keys; reconcile uncertain outcomes, produce confirmed outbox events and expose bounded operation lookup.
acceptance: Commit-before-response-loss replays the identical intent without duplicate graph history; version conflict never becomes blind overwrite.
Cancelled/expired sessions cannot admit new writes; node recovery can inspect existing attempt operations without renewed agent mutation access.

tasks.title: Schedule real graph candidates with explicit eligibility
tasks.scope: Replace test-only task input with bounded graph-ready/context queries and central eligibility/priority/locality decisions; preserve independent local admission.
acceptance: Readiness alone never claims execution; admitted revisions are recorded and invalidating changes prevent stale settlement.
Multiple projects share capacity, cold eligible nodes can prepare work, and decisions/refusals expose reasons without full Git scans.
Schedule only against a current explicit project binding and sealed profile/intelligence selection; unsupported or changed inputs refuse without silently selecting a weaker configuration.

Granted attempts without centrally admitted Started need a separately qualified launch-closure path: exact durable pre-intent suppression or real physical-stop evidence, followed by independent source/effect settlement. Missing Started, expiry or timeout never implies NeverGranted, physical stop or release.

Cold preparation requires a separately versioned accepted no-launch lease and strict fresh confirmation of the exact sealed choice before Grant. Original proposal, budget and source clocks are never retimed; an issued Grant with unusable delivery remains held and needs reconciliation/closure.
Continuing execution requires fresh inventory and scoped installed-material presence evidence; a global credential-availability report cannot invent delivery receipt proof or reset a held grant.

tasks.title: Provision the AQ agent client and bounded context cache
tasks.scope: Package the compatible AQ client, supply protected per-session credential bindings and labelled context snapshots, and handle expired/uncertain request responses.
acceptance: Fake AQ API tests run without the daemon or graph; session/node credential separation is preserved.
Offline proposed edits are never reported as applied; runtime can recover known or centrally listed attempt operations without renewing agent writes.

Provision the digest-bound composed startup/reference context and scoped AQ tool adapter; required context cannot be silently truncated and an access profile cannot be confused with an execution profile.

tasks.title: Integrate local aq-git workspaces and storage admission
tasks.scope: Consume the qualified binary through its public local API for base import, on-demand workspace, checkpoint, retention and safe cache eviction.
acceptance: All ambiguous calls reuse operation IDs; writers stop before checkpoint/retirement.
Alternating projects and disk pressure preserve active/pending data, bound caches and refuse new work when protected storage fills.

tasks.title: Implement authenticated source transfer and central retention
tasks.scope: Implement bounded attempt/repository-scoped artifact endpoints, staging, central aq-git import and retained receipts distinct from upload acknowledgements.
acceptance: Server maps trusted assignment metadata to allowed Git operations and rejects arbitrary worker paths/URLs/commands.
Stale attempts may retain authorized recovery source but cannot restore execution authority or settle newer work.

tasks.title: Implement resumable artifact handoff and retention release
tasks.scope: Add authenticated download/upload, offsets/digests, checkpoint receipts, result attachment and safe local retirement using separate transfer budgets.
acceptance: Restart mid-checkpoint/upload/report preserves IDs and required data; transport success is never central retention.
Central retention survives deletion of stopped worker storage; full pending-result storage blocks admission without blocking control.

tasks.title: Qualify Codex CLI as the first real tmux harness
tasks.scope: Select and pin one Codex CLI/model configuration, implement its adapter on the guarded tmux host, consume the frozen composed launch manifest and prove initial AQ context/tools, process outcome, worktree confinement and explicit folder-grant refusal.
acceptance: Mock configuration tests run without live credentials; exact adapter/CLI versions and required/optional capabilities are recorded. No harness-specific copy of shared role instructions is required.

Real Codex CLI compatibility proves launch, terminal-ready tmux hosting, stop with guardian evidence, scoped AQ reads and confined source edits. Live reattachment stays explicitly unsupported unless separately qualified; no token appears in prompts/argv/logs.
Publish session source identities and parser/usage capability fixtures for WRK-15; INT-03 qualifies the extended transcript/accounting matrix without claiming it from launch/terminal evidence alone.

Integrate the public profiled tmux host with separately typed worker journal/process evidence and any required versioned migration; never coerce new host stop proof into the legacy guardian record. Qualify retention and recovery before advertising profiled launches.

Granted attempts without centrally admitted Started need a separately qualified launch-closure path: exact durable pre-intent suppression or real physical-stop evidence, followed by independent source/effect settlement. Missing Started, expiry or timeout never implies NeverGranted, physical stop or release.
out_of_scope: Closing all-harness product acceptance (WRK-11/12/13 and INT-02 own it)
Claiming hostile-code isolation or live reattachment from tmux persistence

tasks.title: Retain native stopped result claims and expose validated owner reads
tasks.scope: AQ-10 stage B1 only: immutable bounded report recording after actual Started/Stopped, pinned expected outcome, correction-head CAS and historical owner reads under common authority locks.
acceptance: Actual PostgreSQL and HTTP tests require exact physical stopped proof and typed outcome owner; stale credentials cannot record and exact report replay is immutable.
Historical owner reads validate report/receipt/spec/manifest/outcome and stop provenance, expose current-head versus superseded reports, and remain readable after worker credential revocation.
Recording and historical lookup do not release task/source/effect holds, assert live source availability, evaluate eligibility or complete graph tasks.
out_of_scope: AQ-10 stages B2/C: result eligibility, settlement, hold release and expected-version graph completion
AQ-14 human/check execution and current source-retention verification

tasks.title: Apply evidence-based result disposition and graph completion
tasks.scope: Connect immutable worker reports and retained source to pinned outcome/evidence contracts and an authorized version-checked task completion operation.
acceptance: Success text/exit status alone cannot complete a task; stale revisions or cancelled-before-acceptance attempts cannot auto-settle.
Graph completion remains pending until confirmed; crash/replay emits one logical completion event.

tasks.title: Publish profile launch, harness capability and terminal contracts
tasks.scope: Publish bounded launch-manifest and worker terminal schemas/types with canonical digests, adapter capability/version declarations, controller fencing, output epochs/sequences and replay dispositions; coordinate human profile/terminal API schemas owned by agent-q.
acceptance: Both endpoints consume pinned fixtures for canonicalization, same-ID conflicts, unknown capabilities, authority/lease expiry, input uncertainty and snapshot/replay boundaries.
Existing foundation behavior and old fixture digests remain compatible; API-01 access profiles are not reused as agent/intelligence/execution profiles. Unsupported new launches decline explicitly.
out_of_scope: Runtime profile resolver, relay or terminal implementation

tasks.title: Build the compositional profile catalog, compiler and explanation CLI
tasks.scope: Implement a small independently tested Rust profile crate, TOML/Markdown catalog validation and immutable activation artifacts; deterministically compose behavior/capability packs, intelligence/execution definitions and scoped context. Add typed inspection API and aq profile validate/explain CLI consumers.
acceptance: Golden manifests prove deterministic order/digests, identity-based deduplication, cycle/version/conflict rejection, explicit overrides, permission ceilings and required-context overflow refusal without live providers or a database in core tests.

Activation is revision-checked, invalid edits preserve the old catalog, active attempts retain exact revisions, and explanations expose provenance/omissions without secrets. Required denied tools cannot silently disappear.

Seed implementer/reviewer/researcher/supervisor recipes reuse shared instruction/pack identities across harnesses; unavailable required adapters keep recipes ineligible rather than producing misleading working defaults.

Define an optional dependency-wait capability pack for scoped wait register/checkpoint/show/ack tools and end-turn/bootstrap instructions; keep it ineligible until the M5 adapters exist, without blocking the M4 baseline recipe or granting operator recovery rights.
out_of_scope: A second editable profile database, deep inheritance, runtime LLM composition, arbitrary executable pack hooks

tasks.title: Implement project execution bindings and policy administration
tasks.scope: Add revisioned central project records referencing public repository binding/generation and graph workspace identities, allowed profiles, worker eligibility groups, policy/context revisions and budget ceilings; provide bounded authenticated administration/inspection operations.
acceptance: An operator can bind an existing supported repository and graph workspace without editing private component state; absent, stale or unauthorized bindings prevent scheduling with explicit reasons.

Updates use expected revisions, profile activation does not mutate running attempts, and project records never become a second task lifecycle store. Required node/environment restrictions remain centrally controlled.
out_of_scope: Clone/init/create-GitHub onboarding wizard, copying graph records, per-project preallocated worktree slots

tasks.title: Resolve intelligence and execution choices with bounded provider availability
tasks.scope: Implement deterministic compatible candidate selection from intelligence/execution profiles, project revisions, node capabilities and timestamped provider observations. Record decision traces; add manual observations, structured failure feedback, cooldown and explicit fallback/stale-data policy.
acceptance: Fake clocks/providers prove missing credentials, quota unavailability, unsupported settings, stale/unknown observations, deterministic ties and no-permissible-fallback behavior without provider calls during scheduling.

Freeze concrete choices before offers, recheck sensitive revisions at admission, and require safely reconciled replacement attempts for fallback after launch. Shared retry/budget counters cannot reset; unsupported hard limits refuse.
Provider observations are scoped to the relevant account/credential profile and endpoint/model; a single node failure cannot disable unrelated accounts or authorize a new provider.

Define the accounting/budget-provider interface for AQ-22; final qualification consumes ledger completeness and shared lineage totals. Bootstrap policies cannot claim unsupported hard cost enforcement.
out_of_scope: Implicit provider/model downgrades, automatic quota-probe adapters, editing live attempt configuration

tasks.title: Implement the guarded tmux session host and reusable adapter interface
tasks.scope: Build a small public Rust session-host crate and worker integration: attempt-owned private tmux server/socket/pane, immutable local launch checks, guardian ancestry/expiry, common lifecycle and typed adapter interface. Support central consumption without importing node scheduling/private state.
acceptance: Actual tmux with a synthetic interactive child passes launch-boundary crashes, server/pane identity collisions, daemonization/adopted descendants, expiry/cancellation and guardian-loss uncertainty tests.

No shared existing tmux server, pane exit or terminal EOF substitutes for stopped-writer proof; browser detach/reconnect never stops or relaunches execution, and post-exit inspection cannot spawn a shell.
Independent component tests require no daemon/database/provider credentials; record host resource cost and public package/version compatibility.
out_of_scope: Live execution reattachment, real provider adapter qualification, terminal network relay

tasks.title: Demonstrate a real agent with retained source and graph outcome
tasks.scope: Run one supported repository/task through actual agent context access, code change, source handoff, result policy and confirmed graph mutation.
acceptance: Delete stopped worker data after central retention and show the result remains usable; inject a lost graph response.
Observe explicit authorization/version checks and retain exact source/evidence identities without a worker graph database.

The first real agent uses a frozen composed profile and explicit project/intelligence selection inside the qualified tmux host. This gate covers Codex CLI; INT-02 is required for the four-harness/remote-terminal product claim.

tasks.title: Implement durable supervisor and agent messaging
tasks.scope: Add scoped task/session mailboxes, durable delivery IDs/cursors and acknowledgement states separate from typed cancellation directives.
acceptance: Old-session messages cannot land in a reused slot; sender/recipient scopes are authenticated.
Replay distinguishes received, handed-to-harness, unknown and stale delivery; replies cannot impersonate another session.

Task mailboxes and exclusive thread cursors can feed verified waits; session-addressed mail never silently retargets a successor. Logical message acceptance is separate from notification transport delivery.

tasks.title: Deliver messages through the real harness safely
tasks.scope: Persist mailbox receipt, integrate input at supported harness boundaries and report ambiguous injection without automatic duplicate delivery.
acceptance: Crash between injection and acknowledgement yields explicit uncertainty unless harness IDs prove deduplication.
Cancellation and renewals remain responsive during chat/log/transfer activity.
Use declared native-message or authorized-inbox capabilities for each harness; ordinary messages cannot silently become raw keystrokes or controller authority.
Nudge delivery arbitrates with exclusive human terminal control and suspension, returning deferred/unknown/unsupported rather than typing into an unsafe composer; inbox fallback is explicit.

tasks.title: Host bounded supervisor sessions centrally
tasks.scope: Implement the first central supervisor/assessment execution adapter with resolved role configuration, isolated provider credentials and normal AQ message/API access.
acceptance: Supervisor communicates with remote sessions through durable messaging without entering a worker node.
Bounded session cancellation/results and credential separation are tested; no supervisor secret is provisioned to workers.

Central supervisor CLI sessions use the same pinned host/adapter libraries with central expiring session authority and private credentials, without pretending to be a remote worker. Stop and restart uncertainty are tested.
Central sessions expose observation/nudge and suspend/wake integration seams through public host modules and central permits; complete operations qualification is INT-03.
out_of_scope: General supervisor autonomy or all v1 profiles

tasks.title: Embed the qualified playbook runner with bounded execution
tasks.scope: Pin runner/compiler/storage libraries, bind host authority and outbox input, and isolate synchronous storage/host work from async control handlers.
acceptance: Exclusive ownership, startup/restart recovery, immutable artifacts and activation are integrated without reading AQ tables from the engine.
A blocked storage/host operation cannot stall lease renewal or cancellation; synthetic host commands are not registered as production adapters.

tasks.title: Implement core work, context and operation host adapters
tasks.scope: Register context.read, work.ensure, work.change, operation.get, operation.cancel and message.send against typed AQ services with durable request IDs and finite contracts.
acceptance: Work creation and completion have distinct dispositions; retries cannot create another task/attempt or widen authority.
Host contract fixtures exercise scoped context, owned cancellation, pending effects and exact revision conflicts.
Execution-options/context views and work constraints call the existing profile/selection service; playbooks cannot create an independent model selector or bypass project ceilings.
Host context/event extension points admit only finite schemas; session suspension APIs are not arbitrary work.change or operation-name escape hatches.

tasks.title: Implement judgment, decision and check host adapters
tasks.scope: Implement judgment.request, decision.request and check.request with bounded central assessments, durable human decisions and actual check execution bound to exact subjects.
acceptance: A model assessment cannot impersonate human approval; stale decisions and checks do not authorize changed source.
Async acceptance, completion, cancellation and late outcomes remain distinct and replayable.

tasks.title: Implement candidate preparation and guarded publication policy
tasks.scope: Implement candidate.prepare and candidate.publish with central aq-git, exact retained inputs, required check/review evidence and current destination preconditions.
acceptance: Disposable-remote pilot repairs a conflict with a new candidate and new applicable evidence; publication never runs on workers.
Lost publication acknowledgement reconciles the same operation rather than pushing again; stale evidence blocks publication.
out_of_scope: Publishing user production branches during qualification

tasks.title: Implement findings reconciliation and durable calendar/report coordination
tasks.scope: Implement findings.reconcile, complete scoped observation inputs, finding episodes/notification outbox, and host-owned schedule occurrence cursors for watcher/report pilots.
acceptance: Partial scans cannot clear unseen findings; reminders and notification retries produce one logical message.
Report timeout/fallback and late author completion cannot double-send; timezone/misfire behavior is tested with frozen time.
AQ-27 connects findings/digest notification intents to actual human transport; this service remains the sole episode/suppression and report-window owner.

tasks.title: Publish session observation and continuation contracts
tasks.scope: Publish versioned worker observation/usage provenance, suspension/checkpoint, retained-continuation and bootstrap-ack schemas and fixtures. Coordinate AQ-owned typed wait, notification and operator API contracts without expanding the twelve ordinary playbook commands.
acceptance: Fixtures bind exact session/attempt/node/boot/generation, parser/source event identity, payload digest, stop/retention observations, wait outcome and continuation ack; changed-ID payload conflicts and unsupported capabilities refuse.
Both endpoints can develop against published artifacts/fake peers; preserve old contract behavior and distinguish task outcome, wait resolution, physical parking, wake admission and acknowledgment.
A suspended attempt has a distinct disposition; cooperative parking cannot enter ordinary success/failure task settlement or consume a failure retry merely for hibernating.
out_of_scope: Implementing transcript readers, source verifiers, notification transport or workflow policy

tasks.title: Implement harness transcript readers and durable observation delivery
tasks.scope: Build independent Rust readers/normalizers for the four target harnesses, scoped transcript source discovery, bounded cursor/outbox delivery and public modules reusable by the central host. Advertise actual parser/native usage capabilities at exact versions.
acceptance: Golden source fixtures cover partial records, rotation/truncation, malformed/oversized input, cumulative counters/reset, native history replay, mixed models and parser correction without duplicate usage.

Journal cursor and outgoing facts atomically; fake coordinator tests lost acknowledgments, replay conflicts, source redirection, explicit gaps/incomplete accounting, bounded spool and independent control capacity.

Codex and Claude selected configurations have native token accounting; other absent categories/configurations remain explicit and cannot satisfy complete-accounting policies. Actual four-harness qualification belongs to INT-03.
out_of_scope: Guessing tokens from terminal characters or owning central cost rates/budgets

tasks.title: Implement session observations, transcript inspection and usage accounting
tasks.scope: Ingest normalized replayable observations into scoped session projections and an append-only usage/correction ledger. Add bounded transcript artifact handling, session show/peek/logs/usage CLI and API, rate-card cost estimates and an interface to lineage budgets. Central hosts use the same ingestion semantics.
acceptance: Fake source tests prove cursor/event deduplication, cumulative deltas/reset, overlapping token categories, cross-source precedence, correction provenance and explicit unknown versus reported-zero usage.
CLI/API enforce scopes, freshness, pagination, gaps and cost basis/currency/rate revision. Peek uses bounded published snapshot semantics; no task graph writes per heartbeat/token update.

Retries, provider history and hibernation successors cannot reset or double-count lineage budgets. Estimates are never presented as invoices or unsupported hard spending guarantees; transcript erasure/expiry preserves only policy-permitted accounting facts.
out_of_scope: Inferring semantic progress from token count or retaining unlimited transcripts

tasks.title: Implement the evidence-based session stall ladder
tasks.scope: Implement a persisted deterministic episode policy for suspicion, safe bounded nudge/backoff, stopped-and-retained replacement, quarantine and escalation. Use existing typed messaging/stop/scheduling mechanisms with stable action identities and shared lineage budgets.
acceptance: Fake clocks/evidence exercise long-running tools, provider backoff, registered waits, missing telemetry, human control and meaningful progress; AQ-generated nudges cannot reset progress or be blindly replayed.

Replacement requires stopped-writer proof, source retention and effect reconciliation. Unknown stop quarantines conflicting work; scoped release cannot fabricate proof. Restarts retain rung/cooldown/counters and failed/deferred delivery remains visible.
Terminal ownership and suspension/cancellation are rechecked at action admission; defaults, ceilings and manual recovery are documented and tested without live models.
out_of_scope: Arbitrary session operations in ordinary playbooks or blanket worker/provider quarantine

tasks.title: Implement durable external notification delivery with Discord
tasks.scope: Implement central logical-recipient routing, per-destination outbox, bounded dispatcher, receipt/retry/dead-letter inspection and the first Discord webhook adapter. Publish central protected configuration and operator delivery CLI/API; use no external broker or worker secrets.
acceptance: Fake transport proves enqueue/dispatch/receipt crash recovery, route scope/revocation, rate limits, permanent failures, payload bounds and isolated destination backoff. Transport acceptance never marks human read/ack or a decision.

Ambiguous send reconciles only where supported; otherwise expose delivery_unknown and an explicit duplicate-risk retry policy. Internal stable IDs prevent duplicate logical enqueue, including digest replay.

Missing external routes remain visible while AQ starts and dashboard delivery works; secrets/mentions/private content are controlled. An opt-in real Discord test harness exists for INT-03; unit tests send no human messages.
out_of_scope: Slack/email adapters, inbound Discord conversations or exactly-once claims without provider guarantees

tasks.title: Implement verified agent waits and source subscriptions
tasks.scope: Build scoped agent wait register/show/explain/cancel/ack contracts and a durable wait registry with central scheduling holds. Provide typed task/dependency, message, human decision, timer, operation/playbook and resource source adapters, bounded all/any predicates and authoritative source verification.
acceptance: Register/subscription/reobservation fixtures prove no missed resolution before/during registration or across restart/outbox retention; allocated sequence is not assumed to be a committed watermark. Temporary unavailability remains pending with backoff.

Reject self/cyclic known dependencies, invalid source scopes and changed idempotent requests. Outcomes distinguish satisfaction, failure, cancellation, deadline and unavailable source; events alone cannot satisfy a wait.

Scheduling admission honors central holds despite pending graph projection; graph facts stay with aq-graph. Source generation/revision changes, held message cursors, deadline extension and task cancellation preserve original identity/age/budgets.
Core adapters use fake source owners; concrete decision/playbook/resource integrations are qualified by AQ-27 and GATE-05 without introducing new ordinary runner commands.
out_of_scope: CI/PR/job integrations before their owners exist, arbitrary predicate code or agent polling loops

tasks.title: Implement safe suspension, checkpoint handoff and continuation bootstrap
tasks.scope: Journal fenced suspension, close ordinary input, stop through the guardian, checkpoint final source via aq-git and reuse artifact retention/release. Consume fresh continuation grants and supply bounded bootstrap context with exact-generation agent acknowledgment; expose common mechanisms to central host.
acceptance: Fake coordinator and actual tmux child tests cover crash/lost ack at every checkpoint/stop/upload/receipt/release boundary, early dependency resolution, expired agent credentials and unsupported/missing source. No turn-end or summary receipt substitutes for stop proof.

Confirmed stop can free compute while protected disk remains; safe migratable parking requires central retention and reconciled effects. No stale directive restarts an old process or permits input after suspension.

New attempts restore on an eligible different node without original directory/provider session/credentials. Bootstrap allows scoped reads/ack/recovery only; stale generation and duplicate ack tests preserve one continuation owner.
out_of_scope: Worker-side dependency evaluation, wake scheduling or automatic private provider-state migration

tasks.title: Implement durable hibernation and continuation wake scheduling
tasks.scope: Coordinate bounded warm waiting, requested hibernation, retained parking, immutable wait outcomes and idempotent resume intents. Schedule fresh attempts on eligible workers or the central supervisor host, with source/context handoff, bootstrap ack, held task mail and shared lineage budgets.
acceptance: State-machine tests separate resolved condition, stopped process, central retention, released compute, protected disk, resume_pending, grant admission and acknowledgment. Outcome during parking cannot create overlapping writers.

Daemon restart, node loss, cancellation/supersession versus wake, stale ack, failed launch/ack, resource revalidation and explicit early resume produce deterministic recorded dispositions. One winning attempt per dispatch generation; retries recover its identity.

Warm waits remain grant-bound and bounded; hibernated continuations retain no active grant/slot. Central source permits cross-node wake; missing proof/retention holds conflicting execution and escalates with bounded recovery.

Retention/budget/age survives every wake; dormant storage and predicate counts are bounded, scheduling is fair under wake bursts, and unavailable complete accounting cannot be treated as free capacity or free spend.
out_of_scope: Live-process migration, implicit model/provider conversation carryover or inferred dependency success

tasks.title: Integrate escalation, digest and wait policy with existing playbook commands
tasks.scope: Wire typed session/usage/wait/delivery views and domain events to the registered host catalog. Implement escalation acknowledgment/reminder/resolution, authenticated decision links and digest dispatch through AQ-16 episodes/schedule identities and AQ-24 delivery. Qualify wait sources against real owning AQ adapters.
acceptance: Keep twelve ordinary commands: message.send/decision.request/findings.reconcile and registered operation results use real domain services, while agent suspend/checkpoint/ack stays outside ordinary policy control.

Frozen-time tests prove urgent escalation bypasses digest batching, window/timezone/misfire identities, deterministic fallback versus late author completion, no duplicate logical report and no recursive notification failure storm.

Transport acceptance cannot satisfy human decision/wait; exact authenticated subject revision is required. Wait deadlines/failed wake/stall exhaustion follow explicit supervisor/human policy with useful durable explanations.

Integration fixtures use actual AQ messaging, decision, findings, scheduler and embedded runner with designated fake external transports/providers; no new engine-owned notification or continuation store.
out_of_scope: A Discord reaction approval protocol, unrestricted session-control command registry or duplicated suppression ledger

tasks.title: Accept real policy-driven pilot workflows
tasks.scope: Run coding/review/check/repair, routing, watcher and report pilots against real AQ adapters and the pinned runner, with deterministic substitutes only for designated external model/provider calls.
acceptance: Exactly the agreed twelve production host commands are registered; fake-host passing tests are not substituted for adapter tests.
Crash between domain effect and runner receipt preserves child ownership, authority, deduplication and completion policy.

Required operational mechanisms pass actual AQ service integration for session observation/stall recovery, waits/parking/wake and escalation/digest outbox delivery. External transport/model fault cases may be deterministic here; actual channel, CLI/browser and cross-node qualification is mandatory INT-03.

tasks.title: Establish the playbook storage and scheduling operating envelope
tasks.scope: Reconcile in-progress indexing/retention changes before assigning new work. Measure growing run/event/receipt history, pending children and concurrent admission; enforce tested namespace bounds and assess fairness/queue behavior against the intended AQ workload.
acceptance: Retain scaling data and exact configuration, including synchronous storage costs and quotas; no unresolved work is discarded.
Publish an admissible workload envelope and fail acceptance where required budgets are not met; add scoped optimization tasks to this graph before claiming broader scale.
out_of_scope: Treating the 100-admission microbenchmark as 500-agent product evidence
Silently widening limits after a failing benchmark

tasks.title: Expose task, attempt and workflow explanation views
tasks.scope: Publish bounded browser/client contracts for tasks, attempts, workers, messages, runs and permitted actions with freshness, revision, pending-operation and reason metadata.
acceptance: UI mocks derive from versioned schemas; authoritative state and last observations are distinct.
CLI and dashboard routes share domain operations and authorization; every pending/unknown result is representable.
Include versioned resolved-profile and selection-explanation views; terminal contracts are independently published by CON-02 so relay/bridge development need not wait for this broader API task.
Publish session observation/usage, wait/continuation and notification inspection contracts coordinated with CON-03; UI-04 may develop against fixtures before runtime integration.

tasks.title: Create the independent dashboard application and mock suite
tasks.scope: Initialize the component repository, select a frontend framework, and implement authenticated task/attempt and worker inspection against contract-derived mocks.
acceptance: Build/component/accessibility checks need no AQ daemon, graph or workers.
Large paginated views render stale/unknown/truncated states and untrusted content safely.
out_of_scope: Separate dashboard backend
Full v1 UI parity

tasks.title: Implement pending-safe actions and browser compatibility
tasks.scope: Add one decision/cancellation/message flow through the public API, operation recovery, conflict-preserving drafts and stale-tab compatibility handling.
acceptance: Repeated clicks and lost responses do not duplicate actions or fabricate success; authorization failures are displayed accurately.
Session changes clear protected caches, revision conflicts preserve drafts and incompatible API prompts safe reload.

tasks.title: Version the composite product manifest and component inventory
tasks.scope: Extend the signed release format for exact deployable images, embedded library/binary/UI inventories, API/capability windows and per-owner persistent-state compatibility.
acceptance: Old updaters reject unsupported formats and have a documented upgrade path; version ranges do not replace exact artifact pins.
CI rejects missing/mismatched embedded inventories and local overrides; no second competing component lock authority is introduced.

Manifest/inventory identifies pinned profile artifact formats, shared session-host/adapters, actual harness/tmux versions and tested capability combinations; version strings alone do not claim compatibility.
Pin parser/observation/continuation schema versions, notification adapter and rate-card identities; declare compatibility and protected retention obligations across upgrades.

tasks.title: Implement multi-component update and recovery orchestration
tasks.scope: Extend the existing updater with ordered admission/drain, per-owner migrations, readiness and resumable steps for the assembled stack.
acceptance: Interrupt each update boundary; restore/forward-repair decisions respect actual persistent-state compatibility.
Updates protect renewal/reporting or explicitly drain first; offline older supported workers reconcile after central upgrade.

tasks.title: Package and verify the dashboard in the server release
tasks.scope: Verify the static bundle digest/provenance/API metadata, embed it in the server image, and serve same-origin authenticated application assets.
acceptance: Exact bundle/server browser smoke covers authentication, inspection and one authorized action.
An existing tab detects changed API compatibility and refreshes matching assets without a stale success claim.
The embedded bundle includes the qualified session inspector and terminal UI; old browser/terminal protocol combinations refuse or resynchronize explicitly.
Embedded bundle includes the required session operations, wait/continuation and external-delivery views.

tasks.title: Run the complete product capacity and recovery profile
tasks.scope: Exercise 500 simulated agents across 50 logical workers for the declared duration, graph fixture, sustained/burst rates and network conditions, with real product adapters and measured background/UI traffic.
acceptance: Report latency, failed arrivals, pool/lock/queue waits, control safety margins, retry amplification and retained storage against shared design budgets.
Use restarts, contention, maintenance and reconnect storms; record any missed budget as a release blocker or explicitly narrower candidate scope, not a passing capacity claim.
Measure terminal viewer concurrency, RTT, output rates, latency and overflow separately from total agent count; apply the shared bounded terminal profile while preserving execution-control capacity.

Declare telemetry/dispatcher load alongside 500 active simulated agents and 10,000 dormant continuations with a 1,000-resolution burst. Bound disk/queues and fair wake admission while preserving cancellation/renewal; no idle agent processes are required for dormant records.

tasks.title: Qualify the deployment target and component recovery profile
tasks.scope: On an explicitly selected disposable target, verify ingress/authentication, hosted credential paths, backup/restore, installed artifacts and the supported Git/repository/durability profile.
acceptance: Retain actual host/resource/network/artifact evidence and restore results; local source/test reports do not stand in for deployment proof.

Before any production readiness claim, resolve required component gates, qualify any protection facility used by workflows (otherwise refuse protected values), and document remaining unsupported capabilities.
Verify outbound node long polling and authenticated browser terminal transport through the actual target ingress, including idle timeouts, reconnect, controller expiry and no inbound worker exposure.

Recovery/upgrade exercises parser cursors, notification unknown-delivery/outbox records and retained dormant continuations with fresh scoped wake credentials; no old wire format is silently interpreted as completion.
out_of_scope: Automatic production deployment
Changing live credentials or user repositories without deployment-task authorization

tasks.title: Implement authorized terminal relay and controller leasing
tasks.scope: Implement human terminal APIs and separate bounded node long-poll/output exchanges, scoped subscriptions, exclusive controller leases/fences, durable command dispositions and bounded sequenced replay buffers. Support central-host sessions through a local bridge with the same semantics.
acceptance: Fake peers prove scope separation, exact session/boot/generation binding, lease takeover/revocation/expiry, duplicate/conflicting commands, unknown injection and no offline stale-input replay.

Multi-viewer buffering, output gaps and snapshot barriers remain explicit; terminal traffic never consumes reserved execution-control capacity. Central and remote sessions share authorization without worker secrets in browsers.
No inbound worker endpoint, SSH/reverse tunnel, arbitrary tmux command API or mandatory node WebSocket is introduced.
Implement aq session attach CLI through the same authorized watch/controller relay used by the dashboard; no local-only SSH shortcut. Peek snapshots expose epoch, age and truncation.
out_of_scope: Browser rendering, literal terminal input as domain approval, unbounded transcript retention

acceptance: Configuration fixtures test context/tool delivery, credential protection and refusal of unsupported permissions/models without live services; no copied provider-neutral profile instructions are introduced.
Explicit real-CLI qualification proves initial scoped AQ access, confined source edits, terminal-ready tmux hosting, safe stop/retention and supported grant combinations at recorded versions.
Native messaging/resume/transcript/usage support is stated honestly and independently; successful generic command launch does not qualify the adapter.
Publish session source identities and parser/usage capability fixtures for WRK-15; INT-03 qualifies the extended transcript/accounting matrix without claiming it from launch/terminal evidence alone.

Explicit real-CLI qualification proves initial scoped AQ access, confined source edits, terminal-ready tmux hosting, safe stop/retention and supported grant combinations at recorded versions.

Publish session source identities and parser/usage capability fixtures for WRK-15; INT-03 qualifies the extended transcript/accounting matrix without claiming it from launch/terminal evidence alone.
out_of_scope: Unqualified CLI versions, pretending optional native capabilities are universal

tasks.scope: Implement the OpenCode adapter on the common tmux host; select and pin its tested CLI/model configuration, translate resolved settings and publish its required/optional capability matrix.
acceptance: Configuration fixtures test context/tool delivery, credential protection and refusal of unsupported permissions/models without live services; no copied provider-neutral profile instructions are introduced.
Explicit real-CLI qualification proves initial scoped AQ access, confined source edits, terminal-ready tmux hosting, safe stop/retention and supported grant combinations at recorded versions.
Native messaging/resume/transcript/usage support is stated honestly and independently; successful generic command launch does not qualify the adapter.
Publish session source identities and parser/usage capability fixtures for WRK-15; INT-03 qualifies the extended transcript/accounting matrix without claiming it from launch/terminal evidence alone.
out_of_scope: Unqualified CLI versions, pretending optional native capabilities are universal

tasks.title: Implement the bounded outbound terminal bridge
tasks.scope: Connect verified local tmux sessions to a bounded multiplexed outbound long-poll/output channel. Journal controller/input state, implement snapshot/sequence barriers and explicit loss, and expose reusable local bridge primitives for central sessions.
acceptance: Fake coordinator tests cover dropped acknowledgements before/after injection, injecting-state crash, lease fences, stale boot/pane reuse, expiry and unknown-input refusal without automatic duplicate injection.
Actual tmux tests cover alternate screen, Unicode, resize and snapshot/live races. Bounded buffers/output draining and network saturation cannot block PTYs, guardians, renewals or cancellation.
Reconnect only observes an existing verified session; no inbound listener, shared socket path selection, arbitrary terminal command forwarding or implicit relaunch is possible.
out_of_scope: Provider-specific transcript parsing, full-duplex worker server-push transport

tasks.title: Build profile/session inspection and terminal watch/control
tasks.scope: Add resolved profile/intelligence/execution explanations and an accessible terminal inspector using published central contracts and mock streams. Keep watch, exclusive control, durable messages and typed cancellation distinct.
acceptance: Mock browser tests cover multi-viewer/control handoff, revoked scope, stale tabs/epochs, reconnect, gaps, unknown input and resize without replaying stale keystrokes or relaunching an agent.

Render full-screen/alternate-screen/Unicode output safely with bounded memory, safe escape/link/clipboard handling and a plain-text accessible view. No worker credentials, socket paths or terminal content persist in browser storage by default.
out_of_scope: Direct browser-to-worker connections, a separate dashboard backend

tasks.title: Qualify composed profiles, four harnesses and remote terminals
tasks.scope: Assemble exact pinned daemon/worker/browser artifacts and qualify profile resolution, all four named harnesses, central supervisor tmux hosting, remote watch/control and failure recovery. Record the supported CLI/model/configuration matrix and measured terminal profile.
acceptance: Codex CLI, Claude Code, Gemini CLI and OpenCode each perform the common scoped-context/confined-edit/stop path; shared profile modules are not copied per harness, and incompatible combinations refuse visibly.

Real browser-to-daemon-to-outbound-worker tests demonstrate watch/control, input uncertainty without replay, lease takeover, node/browser reconnect, alternate-screen rendering and central session inspection.

At the declared RTT/viewer/load profile, input-to-echo latency and buffer bounds pass while cancellation/renewal retain their guarantees; credential, node-incarnation and unsupported-version cases refuse. Retain raw evidence and all exact artifact identities.
out_of_scope: Inferring all-harness support from one adapter, live process reattachment, many-agent streaming claims outside measured concurrency

tasks.title: Expose session health, accounting, waits and notification delivery
tasks.scope: Extend session/task views with bounded transcript/usage provenance, stall recovery, typed wait/parking/wake status, retained resources, external message delivery and escalation/digest history. Use versioned central APIs and contract-derived mocks.
acceptance: Component tests display unknown usage versus zero, estimated cost basis/corrections, stale telemetry, deferred nudge, hibernated versus resume_pending, failed/stale wake and released compute versus protected disk.

Actions preserve stable identity/expected revisions and clarify cancel-wait versus cancel-task, early-resume override, ambiguous external delivery and revision-bound human decision. No optimistic proof of successful send/wake/stop.
Safe scoped rendering, accessible status/control and pagination tests run without live workers, providers or PostgreSQL; actual assembled flows are INT-03 evidence.
out_of_scope: Direct worker/provider access or client-owned lifecycle decisions

tasks.title: Qualify session operations, external delivery and cross-node hibernation
tasks.scope: Assemble pinned artifacts and qualify operator CLI/browser interaction, four-harness transcript capability matrix, usage/accounting, stall recovery, actual configured Discord delivery and dependency-driven warm wait/hibernation/wake on two eligible workers plus central supervisor semantics.
acceptance: Actual peek/attach/nudge preserves human control and unknown input semantics; real harness fixtures plus live sessions establish transcript/native accounting support, explicit unavailable fields, corrected estimates and retry/wake budget continuity.

An agent waits for task/message/human/operation/timer/resource conditions, releases compute after safe parking and resumes with retained source/context on another eligible node. Exercise resolution before registration/during stop, node loss, stale ack, cancellation and lost launch response without duplicate writers.

Configured Discord test destination proves actual external acceptance/receipt while fake fault injection covers rate limit, ambiguous send, dead-letter, revoked route and late digest author. Only authenticated AQ decision wakes a human-decision wait.
Record exact versions, credentials/configuration classes (no secrets), retention/buffer/latency/load parameters and raw evidence; one badge or fake transport alone cannot close the product gate.
out_of_scope: Claiming exactly-once provider delivery or unlimited simultaneous terminals/hibernations

tasks.title: Accept a usable, measured and upgradeable AQ product candidate
tasks.scope: Evaluate exact-artifact evidence for the selected capability/profile envelope and record the candidate release decision and unresolved exclusions.
acceptance: All required gates and supported-version checks pass, including browser action, retained source, task policy, upgrade and recovery.
Manifest, runbooks and measured capacity agree with actual artifacts; production publication/deployment is a separate explicitly scheduled action.

Product acceptance requires all four named harnesses, composed/explainable profiles, tmux for remote and central agents, and browser watch/control through the qualified outbound-only relay. A one-harness M4 success cannot waive these requirements.

Require qualified CLI peek/attach/nudge, transcript and honest usage/cost accounting, stall ladder, actual external human delivery and dependency-driven hibernation/cross-node wake. Terminal support or a designed outbox alone cannot waive INT-03.

tasks.title: Remove redundant immutable-artifact work from playbook storage commits
tasks.scope: Instrument PostgreSQL round trips, artifact verification, snapshot and index work; avoid repeated immutable-artifact work only with valid ownership/revision/address evidence. Retain PB-02 workload definitions and budgets.
acceptance: Preserve immutable-address conflicts, integrity validation, artifact garbage-collection races, namespace references, ownership/CAS, rollback and protected key rotation/cold restart.
Repeat the declared five-artifact and reduced PB-02 profiles with durable PostgreSQL settings; retain raw timings and failures rather than claiming broader scale from an empty namespace.
out_of_scope: New external caches/services, weaker integrity/retention checks, widening limits to pass benchmarks

tasks.title: Bound playbook transition persistence costs as history grows
tasks.scope: Use measured allocation/serialization/SQL costs to design and implement versioned incremental persistence or another bounded alternative to whole-namespace transition work. Preserve one authoritative storage owner and atomic domain boundaries.
acceptance: Prove crash/rollback/restart equivalence to the reference snapshot model for events, receipts, waits, children, effects, indexes and quotas, including ownership/incarnation fences and replay.
Provide migration and protection/rotation behavior; retain fair ready/effect discovery and refuse overload without dropping unresolved work or silently resetting bounded retries.
Repeat all PB-02 history, child, concurrent admission and backlog profiles with explicit synchronous costs and memory; missed budgets remain release blockers.
out_of_scope: A second editable workflow-state store, arbitrary eviction of unresolved work, a 500-agent claim from component microbenchmarks

design_updates.summary: Required compositional agent/execution/intelligence profiles, explicit project bindings and provider selection, mandatory tmux for every real agent CLI, four qualified harnesses, and outbound-only remote terminal watch/control. M4 proves the first adapter; M6 requires all four and the browser terminal experience. Existing completed task evidence is unchanged.

Required session peek/attach/nudge, transcript and usage accounting, bounded stall recovery, Discord notification delivery, escalation/digest policy and verified agent suspension/hibernation with cross-node wake. M5 mechanisms and M6 product qualification are mandatory; earlier completed evidence remains unchanged.

Three-area design/implementation reconciliation: full state24 checkpoint778tests; ordered state25 source-owner/read integration with38focused checks; exact native control, private material and source-client components with26worker tests. Durable native driver, physical terminal baseline and human/check integration continue; product gates remain open.

Extract completed AQ-10 B1 ledger/owner-read slice as AQ-28. AQ-14 consumes that frozen owner boundary rather than waiting for full AQ-10 settlement; human decision/check receipts can develop before the evaluator that consumes them. B2/C and all product acceptance gates stay open.

First dashboard-read-1 API and verified static bundle are connected to the independent dashboard: 234 unit/component,35 mocked browser/accessibility and4 actual-daemon checks. Exact source and fixture limits are retained; API-02/UI-01 and broader product gates remain open.

Ordered state25→27, native preparation and explicit optional playbook lifecycle are integrated. Worker no-launch journal/observed tmux host passed retained Git/host/relay checks; one concurrent-load deadline failure remains explicit. The assembled daemon passed45 selected tests and4livebrowser checks after fixture upgrade. Native offers/grants and full driver continue in parallel; product gates stay open.
